receipt_sha256: May be null for failed; otherwise strict SHA256. Never evidence of successful execution merely because present. Succeeded still requires a completed receipt.
definite_no_R: A legally claimed attempt with runtime and started_at was rejected or failed before R launch, with trusted no-child evidence. This does not permit a queued admission without any attempt to become failed.
not_claimed: Missing registration, unavailable service or unclaimed work stays queued or yields existing HTTP rejection; no fabricated null-runtime failed terminal state.
unknown_cleanup: Remain running with reconciliation_pending; no automatic retry, no new R and no failure inferred from error code alone.
